notes.title: Vanaris Tactics Has Arrived on Steam! Strike and Obtain Your Freedom!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=hSdnGZpsQ0Q;full][/previewyoutube]
Greetings, Stalwart Tacticians.

Join Adrien, Morgana, and Nigel as a band of refugees who tried to fight the tyranny and obtain freedom outside the walls of Vanaris. Meet more comrades along the way, uncover the truth behind the rebellion, and command them carefully to fight and live to see another day. The story starts with our three protagonists getting ambushed by their kind. 

Can you separate between the true ally and who is the real enemy? 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41118451/e7bcb3c28a16d23f3fa199d0761f1ed6ab2342c1.gif

Strategize your move, choose different character skills, and upgrade your equipment as you move forward to fight tougher enemies. The more you reach towards freedom, the harder the enemies become.  Be determined and stand your ground to fight, even if you will meet unlikely foes! 

Vanaris Tactics is solo developed by a Brazilian developer, Matheus Reis, who was working hard to make his game into reality with the help from Toge Productions. After so many iterations and planning, the game is finally out and we hope everyone can enjoy the game. 

Pick Up Vanaris Tactics Now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1599860/Vanaris_Tactics/

Once again, thank you for your support.
Especially the community who have been highly supportive of us.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41118451/bd6e372ad384ec1cfa24f7b659bfa45d8112c074.gif

notes.title: Vanaris Tactics Demo is Now Available as a Prologue Chapter
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41118451/a0642a85a8e7884e4140dc4c888f68a9e1b7d21f.png

Greetings, Stalwart Tacticians! 

We have some great news for all the tacticians who have yet to try to demo with its limited time period availability. The demo is now available as a separate Prologue chapter that is free to play for everyone at any time.

[previewyoutube=RiBs3vczGnY;full][/previewyoutube]

Play the Vanaris Tactics - Prologue
You can directly play the prologue and experience the first few scenes of Vanaris Tactics. We would be very pleased to receive a review if you are willing to leave one. It would really help us to improve the game before the final release.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1610350/Vanaris_Tactics__Prologue/

Vanaris Tactics is a fantasy turn-based RPG telling a story about a ragtag group of refugees seeking a safe haven outside the wall of Vanaris. Play the demo and get to know the main characters Morgana, Nigel, and Adrien as they fight as rebels to gain their freedom from a place they once called home. This game is developed by solo developer Matheus Reis from Brazil and published by Toge Productions.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41118451/ca1ae843eb6b4f2ef422ef049516e779302d36fa.gif

The full game is currently still in development and is planned to be released later this year. Feel free to wishlist Vanaris Tactics if you are looking forward to it. We will do our best to stay in touch with everyone about the development of the game. Expect more gameplay mechanics and story bits being teased from our social media. 

Until then, we hope to inform you with more new updates of the game.
